pathParams.name: billId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the bill to update

attributes.name: AccountNumber
attributes.description: For utility billing. The account number associated with the bill, used by a utility vendor to identify the account

attributes.name: CheckMemo
attributes.description: The memo on the check

attributes.name: DueDate
attributes.description: The date the invoice is due

attributes.name: InvoiceDate
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received

attributes.name: LineItems
attributes.description: Array of line item attributes present on the bill(s). DO NOT INCLUDE Line Items unless one or more details have changed (including them causes other parts of system to assume changes and create new Auditing/version history entries)

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount due for the line item

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief description of line item

attributes.name: GlAccountId
attributes.description: The general ledger account ID relevant to line item

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: The PropertyId associated with the line item. This takes precedence over the top-level PropertyId connected to the bill.

attributes.name: ServiceFrom
attributes.description: The start date of the utility vendor's service

attributes.name: ServiceTo
attributes.description: The end date of the utility vendor's service

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: The unit ID relevant to the line item

attributes.name: ManagementCompanyAsPayee
attributes.description: Indicates whether the management company is the payee for the bill. Required and must be true when VendorId is null or not provided.

attributes.name: PostingDate
attributes.description: The accrual-accounting invoice date

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the the property associated with the bill. If a PropertyId is not found within the LineItem array, use this value for reference purposes.

attributes.name: Reference
attributes.description: The reference number to the invoice number. This number must be unique, no duplicate record is allowed.

attributes.name: Remarks
attributes.description: A description or summary of the invoice

attributes.name: TotalAmount
attributes.description: The total amount due. Ensure that the total amount is equal to the total of all items summed.

attributes.name: VendorId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the payee's vendor ID. Required when ManagementCompanyAsPayee is false or not provided. When present, ManagementCompanyAsPayee cannot be true.

attributes.name: WorkOrderId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the work order corresponding to the invoice. The value of WorkOrderId cannot be null.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated bill
